Picos de Europa National Park: the park’s detailed FAQ says camping is limited to authorised campsites or near villages with the owner’s permission. It describes bivouac without a tent above 1,800 m for mountain traverses, with exceptions, and tents only in adverse weather or force majeure. The same page retains an older 1,600 m summary, so confirm the current regional rules and location with the park.

Picos de Europa National Park: the park’s FAQ says fires are prohibited apart from controlled park-management work, and swimming in lakes and rivers is prohibited. Its general summary mentions possible designated bathing areas, so check local signs and current park guidance.

events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils) and elections to this community's regional parliament, Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years, unless a regional president with the power to dissolve calls an earlier election.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called: the call is issued by decree about 54 days before.
